articles.title: Adani Enterprises Q2 Results: Revenue spikes 75% YoY to Rs 37,216 crore, profit at Rs 1,492 crore
articles.content: Adani Enterprises has reported a 55% drop in consolidated net profit for the second quarter of FY27, with figures reaching Rs 1,492 crore compared to Rs 3,304 crore from the previous year. Conversely, operational revenue surged by 75%, hitting Rs 37,216 crore. This stark contrast is notable due to the previous year's inflated profits, driven by exceptional gains totaling Rs 3,583 crore, highlighting a dramatic shift in financial performance.

articles.title: No. 2 on Day 1: How Jio Platforms broke India’s market cap hierarchy in debut trade
articles.content: Jio Platforms made a blockbuster stock market debut, listing at a 21.3% premium over its IPO price of Rs 1,119 at Rs 1,358 on the BSE. With a market capitalisation of around Rs 12.5 lakh crore, it became India’s second-most valuable listed company after parent Reliance Industries, overtaking Bharti Airtel. The debut also made Jio India’s largest listed telecom company, placing it ahead of major players such as TCS, SBI and Bajaj Finance.
